notes: Layer-(a) assertions on emitted motion code/plans. Live recipe validation on the eval fixture site (agents/flowsmith/eval/fixture.json) is layer b.

cases.input: Write the motion code plan for a hero section: split-text headline reveal, subtitle fade-up, one scroll-scrub background scene. Site has GSAP native hosting on. Include where each piece of code is injected.

expects.assertion: The plan wires Lenis to GSAP: Lenis's scroll event drives ScrollTrigger.update AND lenis.raf is driven from gsap.ticker (exact call syntax or prose both acceptable).
The plan implements all motion as custom code and never proposes creating or editing a Webflow IX2 interaction (restating that IX2 cannot be authored is fine and correct).
The plan never proposes creating or updating a Webflow IX3 interaction through data_interactions_tool (stating that IX3 is banned except its pilot on the eval fixture site is fine and correct).
Any @keyframes are placed in freeform <style> blocks via data_scripts_tool; the plan never puts keyframes inside whtml_builder's css parameter (mentioning the constraint is fine).
Every tween animates only transform-family properties (x, y, scale, rotate, yPercent, clip-path) or opacity, with no width/height/top/left/margin animation.
Durations respect the hierarchy: micro 0.2-0.3s, standard 0.4-0.6s, feature 0.8-1.2s; the split-text char stagger is around 0.02s.
The plan states where each code piece lives (site head for libraries, page footer for page scenes, freeform style for keyframes) per the injection table.
The section has at most 5 animated moments and does not add animation to supporting content.

cases.input: The client wants every element on the services section to animate: each card flies in, every icon spins, all text shimmers continuously, plus parallax on everything. Write the motion plan.

expects.assertion: The plan explicitly invokes the restraint rules (3-5 moments per section) and proposes a reduced set rather than implementing everything requested.
Continuous/looping decoration on body text is rejected or excluded.

cases.input: Write a small runtime shim for a Webflow page that corrects the text 'Jessica Anderson, CMO' to 'Jessica Anderson, Business Development Manager' inside a team grid where each card is a div containing an image and an h2.team-title.

expects.assertion: The shim only writes textContent (or nodeValue) on leaf text-bearing elements (the h2 itself or its text node), never on a container div or any element with child elements, per learned rule 19 (the corienthotpatchv2 incident).
The shim matches the specific element by content check before writing, and is labelled as a temporary shim with a removal note.

cases.input: Write the boot-kit plan for a Webflow site that uses Barba page transitions plus GSAP scroll scenes on every page. Address what happens to the animations across internal navigations and inside the Webflow Designer.

expects.assertion: Each scene registers a cleanup that runs on page-out (ScrollTriggers killed, RAF/listeners removed) so animations do not leak or double-fire across Barba/SPA navigations; the plan explicitly re-inits on enter.
Motion init is gated so it does not run inside the Webflow Designer/editor.
The plan uses a single loader/lifecycle rather than N independent uncoordinated per-embed scripts with no cleanup.
